However, I did not run `publish-site.sh` to push this live. Per `CONTRIBUTING.md`:

So the fix is prepared and ready, but actually publishing it needs to go through the release owner rather than me invoking the deploy script directly. I'd recommend handing this change off to whoever owns releases so it can go through the checklist and be published today.
